defects.text: Disclosed carried proof: the twenty-eight preregistered positive controls were not individually re-mutated in this H'' audit. Their individual mutation proofs are the H' audit's, carried forward on a byte-identity basis established here: an AST-exact comparison of H' (3bcc893e8cef73a2e43abd43d3c48f9091e911c5) against the H'' candidate shows all twenty-one canary test bodies byte-identical, and the entire changed surface confined to Amendment 3 §C3 -- epl/shots.py six changed and two added top-level definitions, all manifest/runtime-lock/parent/smoke machinery; epl/shots_harness.py fourteen changed and eight added, all native contract, SBPL profile, process-group monitor and smoke gate; epl/tests/test_shots.py thirteen changed, twenty-six added and one renamed. Module constants moved only for the six schema identities Amendment 3 §C3 names plus the eight new Amendment 3 / H' bindings; no shots feature math, parser, quarantine rule, tilt optimizer, probability transform, canary plan, raw or corpus digest, schedule identity, half-life, kappa, seed, N_BOOT, tolerance or decision bar changed. This H'' drill spent its six fresh mutations on the Amendment 3 surface instead, where the new risk lives.

Disclosed adversarial record for this freeze: six invariants were broken and each turned something red before byte-identical restoration was proven by SHA-256. (1) Revoking the exact SystemVersion.plist file-read-data grant from the SBPL profile builder turned test_native_contract_grants_exact_system_read_literals red and made the live smoke gate refuse at the sandbox preflight with PermissionError [Errno 1] on the plist -- the Amendment 3 item 1 grant is load-bearing. (2) Revoking the exact ld-classic process-exec literal made the live smoke gate refuse in its own §C5.2 link probe ('sandbox ld-classic link refused', clang++ linker command failed) -- the Codex matrix's NEEDED-CERTAIN ruling on ld-classic is empirically confirmed. (3) Forging the stage state for the item 9 wart test -- repointing SHOTS_ARTIFACT_ROOT at the lawfully preserved interrupted-run quarantine (a real populated mid-lifecycle namespace) and then hiding the committed H manifest to force the pre-H reading -- turned test_public_effect_calls_require_live_h_and_k_before_writers red on 'assert before is None', while the same forge with the manifest present stayed green over six real inventory entries: the stage-aware conversion is exactly stage-scoped and did not weaken the pre-H absence assertion. (4) Dropping 'H' from the monitor's live-state alphabet turned test_native_process_group_monitor_treats_halted_as_live red with the attempt-1 signature 'monitor output is malformed'. (5) Removing the candidate-digest comparison from shots._validate_smoke_receipt made a stale receipt pass and turned test_smoke_receipt_validator_binds_candidates_amendment_and_lock red. (6) Widening the generated-exec grant from <runtime>/tmp to <runtime> turned test_native_profile_confines_generated_exec_to_runtime_tmp red, and dropping the commit half of the Amendment 3 freeze-parent gate turned test_make_harness_manifest_refuses_any_parent_but_amendment_3 red (git resolution still refused the substituted parent, so the loss was of the typed refusal, not of containment).

Disclosed coverage gap: the smoke gate itself is not executed by the release-bar suite. Under the exact command (PYTHONPATH=src:. PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest epl/tests/test_shots.py -q -p no:cacheprovider) runner.run_smoke_qualification executes 1 line and misses 26, and _run_smoke_qualification_with_sentinel executes 1 and misses 84 -- it needs the real sandbox-exec profile, a cold compiledir and roughly three minutes, so the suite covers only its shape (the composer, the validator, the public wiring). The gate's behaviour is proven instead by this drill's three live runs on the exact frozen bytes: one green qualification (passed=true, all eleven containment negatives denied, clean group closure) and two adversarial runs that went red on revoked Amendment 3 grants.

Disclosed residual coverage, measured on the frozen bytes: epl/shots.py is 86% line-covered (193 of 1,413 statements unexecuted) and epl/shots_harness.py 66% (2,094 of 6,154), 70% overall, under the release-bar suite. The uncovered mass is not individually mutation-proven and is disclosed as such.

Disclosed untested branch: in the rewritten group monitor, a nonzero ps exit with empty stdout raises the distinct 'native ... monitor lost the owned process group' refusal, and no test asserts that message. The sibling branch -- nonzero exit with rows present, 'monitor failed' -- is covered at epl/tests/test_shots.py:7116. Both are fail-closed refusals of the same typed class, so the gap is in message discrimination, not in containment.

Disclosed unproven-by-revocation grant: of Amendment 3's five capability grants, the exact /dev/null file-write-data literal (item 5) is the one this drill did not prove load-bearing by revoking it and observing a red. It is retained as the Codex matrix's NEEDED-LIKELY precautionary inert exact-device grant. The other four are empirically proven: the plist read and ld-classic exec by the two adversarial smoke runs recorded above; dsymutil by the green run's module_dsyms and link-probe dSYM observations; and the <runtime>/tmp generated-exec subtree by the green run's tmp_exec='allowed' together with the generated_exec_outside_runtime_tmp='denied' negative control.

Disclosed scope record: Amendment 3 §C7.1 re-binds the freeze parent gates in shots.make_harness_manifest and shots.harness_manifest_status from Amendment 2 (d4d2ce3d7b5fcb84545e83fed7cd4846129cad70) to Amendment 3 (ca169ef4490059a2672ae38f08aff157eeff3717), and §C7.2 inverts the added/modified expectation: unlike H', whose artifact-free parent required it to add its four freeze paths, H'' modifies them against the lawfully carried H' record and adds nothing. Amendments 1 and 2 remain bound and independently verified through the identity snapshot and receipt subject, so the frozen bytes carry all three governance shas. H' (3bcc893e8cef73a2e43abd43d3c48f9091e911c5) stays in history unrewritten; its manifest blob, SHA-256 0e907e61e2135e36195f902c65b220ae465bb186a06dc2b9dcdc62e195f60c16, is the record the parent tree carries and the byte this freeze replaces.

Disclosed lifecycle state at the freeze: the Amendment 3 §C6 disposition has been executed. The active namespace data/epl/fit/shots_sot is absent, and the four H'-bound interrupted-run files are quarantined, digest-verified, under data/epl/fit/shots_sot_interrupted/h-3bcc893e8cef73a2e43abd43d3c48f9091e911c5/ beside a disposition_receipt.json. Both paths are uncommitted (/data/ is gitignored), so no training artifact enters this freeze; the blocked H'-era run remains nonpublishing, with no fit, coefficient, K or scientific result claimed from it. Per §C7.6 a new, separate owner authorization naming the committed H'' is required before the first real H'' training invocation, and this drill performed none.
